svg.title: vLLM KV cache groups: from a layer to a token slot
svg.desc: Block ID 5 means column 5 in every buffer. Buffer k holds position k of every group, so S2 at position 1 uses column 5 of buffer 1. Column 5 of buffer 0 holds S0.
svg.text: 3 · Block ID → one column in every buffer
buffer k holds pos k of every group · buffer 0 = F0 · S0 · S1 · buffer 1 = F1 · S2 · S3
block ID 5 means column 5 of buffer 0 and of buffer 1 · pos 1 picks buffer 1
column 5 of buffer 0 holds S0, the other group 1 layer · groups share the same bytes
